personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: An elegant, Apple-like, map-first real estate experience with premium glassmorphic surfaces floating over rich map layers.

spacing.rule: Generous white space, highly intentional breathing room like an Apple product. Avoid cramped margins.

do's: Floating search pill at top of Map
Property preview cards layered over the map

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium AMASS brand with a cinematic full-bleed experience.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery with a bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Elegant display typography showcasing value props. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Map-First)
screens.purpose: Primary discovery interface mimicking Redfin/Airbnb map UI.

states.loading: Map loading skeleton or subtle pulse
states.empty: No properties found in this area map state

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive map. Floating top glass search pill with secondary filter chips right below it. AMASS Red map pins (clustered). Floating bottom navigation bar with a prominent, elevated central AI FAB. Tapping a pin brings up a glassmorphic floating property preview card just above the bottom nav.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Surfaces neighborhood insights and market trends.
screens.layout: Editorial-style layout. Large typography, rich imagery with subtle corner radiuses. Heat map preview cards and horizontally scrolling trend chips.

screens.name: Property Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific property, driving contact/tour actions.
screens.layout: Full-bleed image gallery at the top with gradient scrim for header icons (back, favorite in AMASS red). Content sits in a bottom sheet-style overlapping container. Sections for details, Mortgage Calculator, AI Valuation. Sticky primary 'Contact Agent' / 'Book Tour' button at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Marketplace
screens.purpose: Tabbed browsing for Properties, Construction, and Home Items.

states.empty: No items found in this category

screens.layout: Clean, spacious 2-column masonry grid for items or single-column for large property cards. Segmented control at the top to switch between tabs (Properties/Construction/Home).

screens.name: AI Search Assistant
screens.purpose: Conversational AI to help users find exact properties.
screens.layout: Chat-like interface accessed via the central FAB. Clean bubbles. AI responses can render inline property cards (miniature versions of marketplace cards).

property_hero_1.alt: Luxury modern real estate home exterior

amass_map_pin.alt: Red map pin (use SVG icon instead in implementation)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Emerald Green (Primary), AMASS Red (Accent - exclusively for map pins, favorites, alerts), Gold (Secondary). Do not use any shades of blue anywhere in the app.

Implement a Map-First Home screen as the core feature. The map should be full-bleed with floating UI elements (Search pill, filter chips, bottom nav) layered over it using glassmorphism (`expo-blur`).
Use custom AMASS red map pins (via SVG or custom marker components) on the map. Tapping a pin must open a floating property preview card or a bottom sheet.
The Bottom Navigation must be floating (not anchored directly to the bottom edge, but hovering above the safe area) with a prominent, visually distinct central FAB for AI Search.
Ensure 'Apple-like' aesthetics: generous white space, large `Satoshi` typography, rounded cards (`lg` radius), and soft shadows/blur instead of hard borders.
Property detail screens must use a gradient scrim (transparent to dark) over the top hero image to ensure icons (Back, Favorite) are legible.
Ensure the Marketplace uses a clean tabbed layout (Properties / Construction / Home) with a segmented control or top tab bar.
Implement haptics on map pin taps, bottom nav changes, and primary actions.
